title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(前田正彦研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III (Maeda Masahiko)
educationalGoal: Theme : Research on your project theme. Through research activities, learn about the significance of research, the research process, the formulation of research plans, research methods, and presentations. Goal : Obtain new knowledge or create unique results based on conventional research. (Related Program Objectives : (G, K, L, M, N))
advice: In order to cultivate the ability to find problems and issues, and to solve problems, you will actually learn the phenomena through experiments while reviewing basic subjects and acquiring specialized knowledge. Not only the superficial understanding of the phenomenon, but also the sense of understanding the essence of the phenomenon. The research process emphasizes mutual communication and discussion. Make sure you fully understand the nature and handling of chemicals and gases used before the experiment. The progress of the research will be reported in the contents of the weekly report and a seminar that is regularly conducted. The seminar will also introduce related research fields and give lectures. The annual schedule is as follows. Previous semester : To clarify the purpose of the research, make a research plan, conduct a literature survey, etc., and acquire basic knowledge to understand the project. In parallel with this, we will clarify the problems to be studied, show specific solutions, and implement them. The effectiveness of the solution is shown by experimental results and theoretical considerations. At the end of the term, the results will be announced at the interim report meeting, and the research results will be reported in a report. Second semester : Further research and solving remaining problems, summarize the research results in a project report, and present it at the public presentation review meeting. At the end of the period, the project will be handed over to the students of the next year.
requiredKnowledge: Project Design III is a creative activity that attempts a unique approach within a limited amount of time to a goal. For this reason, it is required to study basic knowledge energetically, identify problems and formulate and implement solutions to the problems themselves. It is necessary to have the ability to review the progress so far and to find a better direction through discussions with supervisors, graduate students and classmates. It is necessary to acquire the habit of always recording the contents of activities and learning and making them available later.

activityGoals.body: Be able to clarify the purpose of the project, understand the contents, and draft a research plan.
Be able to communicate with project members and faculty members to promote the project.
Be able to solve problems and issues in project execution.
Be able to summarize activity results in a project report.
Be able to explain the contents of the project, and effectively present the results of activities.
